notes: The catalog offers three tracks (Games Programming, Software Systems, Web Development). The Software Systems track was used because it is the only one checked that requires an algorithms course (CPSC 4115); the Games Programming track page was also read and shares C1, C2 and C4. The program PDF link on the degrees page timed out. Columbus State's university-level AI guidance was not collected here.
